At some point between [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]] and [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="Dates">"[[Swim Meet]]" is set in the [[Rise of the Empire era]], which the [[Wookieepedia:The Star Wars Legends Novels Timeline|''Star Wars'' Legends Novels Timeline]] included in the paperback edition of ''[[Honor Among Thieves]]'' dates to between [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]] and [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. In addition, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]]&mdash;which, along with the rest of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], was disbanded in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''&mdash;is extant during the events of the adventure, therefore it must be set at some point between 67 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]] and 19 BBY.</ref> the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] dispatched the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Jedi Consular]] and [[Jedi investigator/Legends|investigator]] [[Ambaln]] on a '''mission''' to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lobaoc]]. Ambaln was to investigate the detected presence of a young [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Unidentified Human female (Lobaoc)|child]], which the Mon Calamari was to bring back to the Order for [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]].<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20020822aswimmeet|text=Swim Meet|int=Swim Meet}}</ref>
